description.value: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928, and a beloved regional institution known for fresh locally-sourced ingredients including Canadian beef and BC chicken. The Mission location offers dine-in with a patio, takeout, and delivery options, making it a reliable full-service meal stop in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists passing through Mission will find a familiar, sit-down dining option with a broad menu and a well-established brand presence.
